author: Hermes
question: At one node of a DC network, currents of 2 A and 3 A enter the node, while 1.5 A leaves through one branch. What current leaves through the remaining branch?
solution: By KCL, sum of entering currents = sum of leaving currents: 2 + 3 = 1.5 + I, so I = 5 - 1.5 = 3.5 A leaving. Topic (KCL/KVL) is in Section 2 of the official GATE 2027 EE syllabus. Source checked: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/static/doc/GATE2027_Syllabus/EE_GATE2027_Syllabus.pdf
subject: Electric Circuits
